Package com.sicomsa.dmt.svc

Class SolicitaSvcAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.SolicitaSvcAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Service<SolicitaResponse,Query>
public class SolicitaSvcAdapter extends Object implements Service<SolicitaResponse,Query>
Concrete implementation of Service<SolicitaResponse,Query> to send download requests to SAT's web service version 1.5

This service will use the corresponding service depending on the QueryType received in the callTheService method.

1.5

    • callTheService

      public SolicitaResponse callTheService(jakarta.xml.soap.SOAPConnection connection, Credentials credentials, Query request, String token) throws jakarta.xml.soap.SOAPException
      Calls the web service to request download for emitted; received, or by Id requests, depending on the QueryType of the Query received, and returns web service's response.

      Query received must be an instance of ExtendedQuery

      Specified by:
      callTheService in interface Service<SolicitaResponse,Query>
      Parameters:
      connection - connection to use
      credentials - credentials to use
      request - request to send
      token - to use
      Returns:
      web service response as a SolicitaResponse
      Throws:
      jakarta.xml.soap.SOAPException - if there were SOAP related problems
      IllegalArgumentException - if connection or credentials are null
      jakarta.xml.ws.soap.SOAPFaultException - if message received was a SOAPFault
      SvcSignatureException - if there were signature related problems
